    if agent_name:
        agents.append(agent_name)

# Extract agent-category assignments (rows 4-9, columns F-N for Categories 1-9)
# We'll create a dict: agent_name -> list of category assignments
agent_categories = {}
for row_idx, row in enumerate(range(4, 10)):
    agent_name = ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value
    if agent_name:
        categories = []
        for col in range(6, 15):  # F to N (Categories 1-9)
            val = ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value
            categories.append(1 if val == 1 else 0)
        agent_categories[agent_name] = categories

# Extract agent schedules (rows 13-18, columns F-AE)
# We'll create a dict: agent_name -> list of time slot assignments
agent_schedules = {}
for row in range(13, 19):
    agent_name = ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value
    if agent_name:
        schedule = []
        for col in range(6, 32):  # F to AE (26 time slots)
            val = ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value
            schedule.append(1 if val == 1 else 0)
        agent_schedules[agent_name] = schedule

# Now calculate the totals for each category and time interval
# Answer position: F22:AE29 (8 categories × 26 time slots)
# Row 22 = Category 1, Row 23 = Category 2, ..., Row 29 = Category 8

for category_idx in range(8):  # Categories 1-8
    category_row = 22 + category_idx
    
    for time_slot_idx in range(26):  # 26 time slots
        time_slot_col = 6 + time_slot_idx  # Column F to AE
        
        # Count how many agents are working this time slot AND have this category
        count = 0
        for agent_name in agents:
            # Check if agent has this category (category_idx is 0-based)
            has_category = agent_categories.get(agent_name, [])[category_idx] if category_idx < len(agent_categories.get(agent_name, [])) else 0
            
            # Check if agent is working this time slot
            is_working = agent_schedules.get(agent_name, [])[time_slot_idx] if time_slot_idx < len(agent_schedules.get(agent_name, [])) else 0
            
            # If both conditions are met, increment count
            if has_category and is_working:
                count += 1
        
        # Write the count to the cell
        ws.cell(row=category_row, column=time_slot_col, value=count)

# Save the workbook
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/53161_4_bb0e654a/1_53161_output.xlsx'
Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
